detailed_descriptions.en: The classic masterpiece from ensemble, Koikata: How Our Love Grows, is officially coming to Steam in a 2K ultra-HD remaster! The story is set at Seiou and Shiraba Academies, two neighboring schools on the verge of a merger brought about by the marriage of their chairpersons. As protagonist Ougi Ren, you'll work alongside the student council presidents of both schools—Tsukishima Saori and Kaburagi Yukie—to tackle tough issues like the shutdown of the dorms and the consolidation of school clubs. Through close collaboration with the students, you'll overcome every challenge and write the first chapter of their new future together.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The classic masterpiece from ensemble, Koikata: How Our Love Grows, is officially coming to Steam in a 2K ultra-HD remaster!

The story is set at Seiou and Shiraba Academies, two neighboring schools on the verge of a merger brought about by the marriage of their chairpersons.

As protagonist Ougi Ren, you'll work alongside the student council presidents of both schools—Tsukishima Saori and Kaburagi Yukie—to tackle tough issues like the shutdown of the dorms and the consolidation of school clubs.

Through close collaboration with the students, you'll overcome every challenge and write the first chapter of their new future together.
